packageRules.description: Disable non-OpenSpec dependency updates in template/package.json (keeps the npm manager active so its lockfile still updates)
Block major pnpm updates (the packageManager pin); minor/patch pnpm still proposed as manual PRs
Re-enable OpenSpec updates in template/package.json; Renovate must not try to update the template lockfile itself (placeholders make pnpm fail), the workflow owns that

commands: pnpm exec openspec config set profile custom
pnpm exec openspec config set delivery both
pnpm exec openspec config set workflows '["propose","explore","new","continue","apply","update","ff","sync","verify","onboard"]'
